BODY - INSTRUMENT PANEL
26. REMOVE INSTRUMENT PANEL
(a) Disconnect the connectors.
(b) Disengage the wire harness clamps.
(c) Remove the J/B set bolts and nuts.
(d) Using a screwdriver, remove the 4 caps.
HINT:
Tape the screwdriver tip before use.
(e) Remove the 2 bolts, nut, 4 screws and instrument panel.
27. REMOVE NO. 1 AND NO. 2 BRACE
28. REMOVE REINFORCEMENT
(a} w/ ABS:
Remove the 2 nuts and ABS ECU.
(b) Remove the 3 bolts, 4 nuts and reinforcement.
